title: AEDIT — Medshop Launch Review
description: Independent launch review of AEDIT Medshop by Mousa Batarseh — a parked domain, sitewide links to a password page, no analytics, and a ten-day go-live countdown. For the Business Operations & Ecommerce Manager role.

blocks.text: SEC. 01 — OVERVIEW · FOR THE BUSINESS OPERATIONS & ECOMMERCE MANAGER ROLE
The launch is stuck at the plumbing.

AEDIT Medshop is linked from every page of aedit.com — to a password-locked myshopify.com address marked “Coming Soon.” The domain it should live on, aeditmedshop.com, has been parked at GoDaddy since February 2025, and the store has no GA4 or Tag Manager. So day one is a domain cutover, tracking and a go-live checklist — not merchandising. Here's the countdown I'd run.
